description: Convert an address, place name, or landmark to geographic coordinates (lat/lon) with structured address data (Geoapify/OSM)

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter results (e.g. "US", "DE", "FR").

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 1, max 5).

text.description: Address, place name, or landmark to geocode (e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC", "Eiffel Tower").

type.description: Filter by result type: city, street, amenity, or country.

name: geo.address.geocode

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Geocode Address
